message: Jeez, what a disturbing story. I don't know if it was supposed to be funny or what...anyway, I too hate cleaning ovens, so much so that I don't even really use my oven. When I've cleaned it, I do all the window-opening and fan-positioning the label suggests, but I still end up coughing. Why can't they make something that's, like, baking soda or vinegar-based?
